passage.text: Tonight's event brings together young people from many different industries in Bangkok.
passage.reading: təˈnaɪts ɪˈvɛnt ˈbrɪŋz təˈɡɛðər ˈjʌŋ ˈpiːpəl frəm ˈmɛni ˈdɪfərənt ˈɪndəstriz ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk.

passage.text: Here is the program for the evening.
passage.reading: ˈhɪr ɪz ðə ˈproʊɡræm fər ði ˈiːvnɪŋ.

passage.text: 6:00 p.m.: Registration at the front desk.
passage.reading: ˈsɪks ˌpiːˈɛm: ˌrɛdʒɪˈstreɪʃən ət ðə ˈfrʌnt ˈdɛsk.

passage.text: Please pick up your name tag and your free welcome drink.
passage.reading: ˈpliːz ˈpɪk ˈʌp jʊr ˈneɪm ˌtæɡ ənd jʊr ˈfriː ˈwɛlkəm ˌdrɪŋk.

passage.text: 6:45 p.m.: Our guest speaker, Malee Somboon, the founder of Malee's Noodles, will talk about starting a business.
passage.reading: ˈsɪks ˈfɔːrti ˈfaɪv ˌpiːˈɛm: aʊr ˈɡɛst ˈspiːkər, ˈmɑːliː sɑːmˈbuːn, ðə ˈfaʊndər əv ˈmɑːliːz ˈnuːdəlz, wɪl ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ˈstɑːrtɪŋ ə ˈbɪznəs.
ˈnaɪn ˈθɜːrti ˌpiːˈɛm: ði ɪˈvɛnt ˈɛndz.

passage.text: Wear your name tag on the right, so that people can see it when they shake your hand.
passage.reading: ˈwɛr jʊr ˈneɪm ˌtæɡ ɑːn ðə ˈraɪt, soʊ ðæt ˈpiːpəl kən ˈsiː ɪt wɛn ðeɪ ˈʃeɪk jʊr ˈhænd.

passage.text: Don't just talk to people you already know.
passage.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈdʒʌst ˈtɔːk tə ˈpiːpəl juː ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈnoʊ.

passage.text: Ask questions and listen carefully. People remember good listeners.
passage.reading: ˈæsk ˈkwɛstʃənz ənd ˈlɪsən ˈkɛrfəli. ˈpiːpəl rɪˈmɛmbər ˈɡʊd ˈlɪsənərz.

passage.text: Bring business cards, or keep your contact details on your phone.
passage.reading: ˈbrɪŋ ˈbɪznəs ˌkɑːrdz, ɔːr ˈkiːp jʊr ˈkɑːntækt ˌdiːteɪlz ɑːn jʊr ˈfoʊn.

passage.text: After the event, send a short message to the people you met within two days.
passage.reading: ˈæftər ði ɪˈvɛnt, ˈsɛnd ə ˈʃɔːrt ˈmɛsɪdʒ tə ðə ˈpiːpəl juː ˈmɛt wɪˈðɪn ˈtuː ˈdeɪz.
